Watch Bridge is an open source app. It is developed by the community, for the community.

Anyone is welcome to contribute via code, documentation, testing and donations.

Watch Bridge contains no ads and no tracking. It keeps your data locally on your Android device, so it is 100% privacy friendly.

Permit access to the Internet Helper for Watch Bridge add-on app

To transfer files, Watch Bridge starts a Wi-Fi hotspot on the device, and the Internet Helper connects the phone to it. Android asks you to confirm this connection.\n\nWhile the connection is open, the phone can disconnect from other Wi-Fi networks, and the device uses more battery. The connection will be closed automatically when you leave the screen. You can also close it from the notification.
